ai.title: AI for science needs reasoning, not just data
ai.brief: AI agents that can model the human process of research will accelerate discoveries in science. Every few decades, someone announces that science has reached its end. ” In the 1980s, Stephen Hawking predicted that theoretical physics might be finished by the end of the century. With the explosive arrival of artificial intelligence, the feeling is in the air again—this time accompanied by a Nobel Prize.
